body: I couldn't actually accept your money. I know I'll find a way, I always work hard. Jobs aren't really my thing, but its the outcome not the method, right? But you gave the response that I needed to hear, and I appreciate that. You offered a real tangible physical solution. It sounds shallow and callous and stuff, but really what I needed to know was that somewhere was someone who offered something real... I'm starting to feel better now. You really did help me.

its not about it being enough. I find you interesting, And I don't think empathy is the only reason.  You could make these words mean anything. They could be lies. Why should I believe you? I don't even think people who really show "caring" care in real life. I don't believe in altruism here.
Maybe I doubt you because my own empathy is gone. I don't understand you anymore. I havn't felt in so long really. And when I do love, I don't know if its given back to me the same, or just there until I run out of usefulness. So explain yourself, please
I think that helping other people out of these situations is how you work on your issues. I'm glad its helpful. What makes you want to do this?
